Sensational food, wonderful staff
Dec 2019 • Couples
My hubby and I came here for dinner tonight and it was truly exceptional. Everything was incredibly tasty and the owner was so sweet, helpful and friendly. We ordered the "Uplifting" salad which was delicious, the crispy fried mushrooms which were AMAZING!! We also ordered the vegan beef which came on a sizzling hot plate and this was just sensational! Every single dish was superb, we hopefully will get the chance to visit again before we leave HCM. Lovely ambience too!😄Highly recommend!!

Amazing totally Vegan restaurant
Nov 2018 • Couples
Wow!! This place is incredible, totally Vegan food and the staff are all Vegan too. The staff are incredibly friendly and happy to chat when it’s quiet. They went above and beyond our expectations. 
The food was delicious, everything we tried was yummy, fried spring rolls, pad Thai, pineapple rice, blessing light spaghetti, fruit ice-cream crepe cake. The ice-cream was amazing, even my husband who isn’t a vegan said it’s better than normal ice-cream. 
Definitely worth a visit, we went twice. 
Thanks everyone at Phuc Quang Chay for such a wonderful experience. Julie & Garry
